item.title: Being Alone:
item.content:encoded:
This strikes me as a little too serious. While I can certainly see Duke painting portraits of himself with the tears of orphans, overdramatic idiot that he is, I can’t read about it without laughing at the sheer dramatic ridiculousness of such a thing. I figured he was just gonna eat the kids, since they were presumably virgins.

I also think you have too many “y”s in people’s names, and that using a real city instead of “Noxus” would be better. The Foundationverse mostly resembles the real world on the surface, not some fantasy setting.

+ show block
– hide block

The thing about the names leads into the biggest criticism: there is nothing SCP about this story. I could’ve conceivably read the same thing about any fictional vampire, and the usage of a fictional city and unrealistic names deepens the impression that this story is supposed to be something else but you decided to slap Duke on it and post it here instead. That might be okay if the character was still recognizably Duke, but he’s got weird powers we’ve never heard of before (turning fountains into portals) and acts different from the asshole in the file and the tale.

I commend your bravery in trying to write a tale about an SCP-D, but remember this thing was decommissioned for a reason: it sucked (pun intended). If you want to write something serious about Duke, it’s got to be very much not sucky, and that’s hard.

item.title: SCP-5580:
item.content:encoded:
I love it. Very well written, as expected, but the articles really comes into its own with its amalgamation of themes. Fifthism, IJAMEA, and Lyle Burnley seem very obscure and incompatible (probably making it the hardest request of the Art Exchange) yet you succeed with flying colors in combining these entities' essences. I would never think to relate Fifthism's reality-bending madness to colonialism's truth-garbling horrors. Perhaps more impressive, it uses all these factors without relying on other source material for understanding.

Simply put, +1

item.title: SCP-5870: This Author Post is Sponsored by the Koalalition
item.content:encoded:
Hello! Veralta's here with a new SCP about koalas, nature, the future of Australia, and intricate worldbuilding based on the beliefs of aboriginal Australian people like the Bundjalung and the Eora. Consider this SCP a free New Year trip through Australia, and a little bit of a crash course on the Australian condition.

Also, it's linked to Ralliston's Obearwatch Command; fun fact, all of these started when he threw the word "Koalalition" at me, and I said, "Hmm… uwah, this looks interesting". I initially planned out a short article with a gimmick and a punchline.

But then, I realized I had to dive deep into the waterhole.

The aboriginal Australian belief system, also called Dreamtime1, is very complex and interesting. It would be a shame if I just went with a silly punchline when aboriginal culture, with its mix of hopes and dreams for Australia, needs a chance to shine here.

Lastly, consider this article as a piece dedicated to Australians and wildlife - such as the koalas themselves - who have been affected by the severe bushfires. As a Filipino youth, I couldn't do much to be honest, aside from raising awareness. I tried to stay true to the myths' essence while adding my style of writing to them, while I researched news about the bushfires.

All in all, though, please enjoy this SCP, and I wish a Happy New Year - and more happy years - to come for all of us!

Special thanks to Ralliston2, Meisteroni, DrChandra, Rose the Changeling , for concept checking and making my narrative is solid. Dysadron and caspian2 also have my gratitude for their comprehensively good LBL and critique. Last but not the least, I also want to give a deserved shoutout to Dr Balthazaar for providing guidance on Australian beliefs and culture. You guys are amazing!

Footnotes
1. By the way, this word does not cover what the beliefs really mean, and while dreaming is a part of the culture, it is not just that. Additionally, the word "Dreamtime" may even be just a mistranslation of words meant for deities.
2. Bear goes rawr :p
